title: International Perspectives on Politics and Society
description: Explores international perspectives on the linkages between the political realm and civil society. Examines the socio-political dynamics of the Global South and provides a comparative analysis of these dynamics between the Global North and Global South. Topics may include civil society and democracy, party politics in the Global South, nationalism, corruption, political agency, the dynamics of political repression, state violence against its citizens, social movements and police brutality.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 331, SOCI 330.
recommendations: SOCI 207 recommended prior to SOCI 331. Recommended prior to SOCI 436.
